_comment: Dungeon catalog (real data drives the schema). A Dungeon is an *authored* multi-level dungeon — id, display name, and an ordered list of Dungeon Level ids. Each Dungeon Level points at a Map record that holds the actual tile grid. This is distinct from Dungeon Config (in dungeon_configs.json), which describes a *procedural* generator's input parameters — authored dungeons are entirely hand-painted maps, procedural ones are rolled at runtime. The catalog ships empty; populate as adventures are designed. See docs/data_dictionary/dungeon.md.
